name: governed-operations
description: Multi-sig governance on Hedera native primitives: a threshold key holds the quorum and the Schedule Service holds each proposal until the council signs from HashPack or Kabila. Ships contract upgrades, SaucerSwap treasury swaps, HTS token admin, transfers and council rotation, plus an optional co-signing agent that publishes its decisions to HCS.

steps.label: Set the operator, council and WalletConnect variables
steps.text: HEDERA_OPERATOR_ID and HEDERA_OPERATOR_PRIVATE_KEY from a testnet account; HEDERA_COUNCIL_ACCOUNT_ID, your own account id, which becomes one of the council keys that approve proposals; NEXT_PUBLIC_WALLET_CONNECT_PROJECT_ID from Reown Cloud.

steps.label: Create the governance account
steps.text: First of two runs: creates the topic, the demo accounts and the account holding the council's threshold key, then hands the deploy the values it needs through packages/hardhat/.env and stops, listing what is not deployed yet.

steps.label: Deploy the contracts
steps.text: The contracts are deployed against the governance account, so they come after the first run — see Contracts below.

steps.label: Finish the bootstrap
steps.text: Second run: creates the HTS token the council administers and leaves one proposal pending for it to approve. Idempotent — a third run creates nothing.

steps.label: Try the demo
steps.text: Open a proposal from New proposal, sign it from the live map with a council wallet (Kabila or HashPack), and watch the network execute it once the threshold is met.

steps.label: Create a deployer account
steps.text: Stores an encrypted key in packages/hardhat/.env, then fund it from the testnet faucet.

steps.label: Deploy to Hedera testnet
steps.text: Every deploy regenerates packages/nextjs/contracts/deployedContracts.ts, which is what the frontend reads.

steps.label: Verify on HashScan
steps.text: Submits the deployed contracts to Sourcify and prints their HashScan links.

steps.label: Runbook
steps.text: docs/RUNBOOK.md — reproduce on testnet end to end, verify with the Mirror Node and HashScan, troubleshoot.

steps.label: Architecture
steps.text: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md — signing flows, module map, verified network constraints.

steps.label: Glossary
steps.text: docs/GLOSSARY.md — Hedera terms as used in this template.
